name: Brian Fee
text: Best urgent care. Nurse and doctor are awesome.

name: Brooke Bordelon
text: Love this place for my kids!

name: Mikayla Moore
text: Quick service. Dr was extremely nice and explained everything clearly.

name: Rhonda Ragsdale
text: We have been coming for years with my children. The staff is always great and caring. I would give 10 stars if I could!

name: Brittany
text: Very kind and caring, and worth the wait.  I appreciate the help that they have given my family many times with some complicated issues that needed to be addressed, we always leave with a plan of action.  Thank you.

name: Kenzie Beckham
text: Here right now everyone is so nice and I love the staff so much and they are very clean and I love their art on the wall and they are really fast definitely coming back!!!

name: Autumn Black
text: My daughter and I love this place. Everyone involved from the front desk to the doctors were extremely knowledgeable and really made my daughter comfortable, listened to my concerns and explained in depth anything I asked about. Love this place, thank you!

name: Tiffany Whitworth
text: We had a great experience! Ms Sue was great with my little guy. I'd totally recommend this place. We didnt have a long wait at all, but even if we had to wait longer it would have been worth it for how thorough the visit was.

name: Lauren Rivera (Mrs. Dzio)
text: I wish I could give them a 10 star rating! From the moment I walked in, the whole experience was incredible. The theme of the clinic its self is so cute; the secretary was kind, the medical assistant was careful to detail and the provider was so knowledgeable and listened to all of my concerns. She asked really helpful questions and showed she was really interested in understanding how to best help my baby boy 🩵 I would recommend this place to everyone !!

name: Melissa Scharber
text: We are incredibly grateful to Susan and her entire team for going above and beyond while caring for our sick child. From the moment I spoke with her and her team, everyone showed compassion, patience, and genuine concern. They took the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and made a very scary situation much easier for our family. We cannot thank them enough for the care and dedication they showed. Truly an amazing team.

name: Ana
text: I have nothing bad to say about this clinic, my kids always go here when they are sick, and they are always welcomed with a smile. The NP/Doctor’s have always explained everything in detail, answer all my questions. They are patient, they have cartoons in the room so kids wont get fuzzy and they offer ice pops to the kids. This clinic is amazing and hope they stay open for a while. The clinic is painted cheerful and my kids love the farm theme. They also try to get you affordable medication or make sure the medication is covered by your insurance. I highly recommend this clinic. NP Susana is amazing and caring, all the staff in the clinic are caring and you can see it as soon as you walk in.
